description: UART 16550 serial port for character I/O

registers.name: THR_RBR
registers.description: Transmit Holding Register (write) / Receive Buffer Register (read)
registers.behavior: Write byte to transmit. Read to receive next byte from input buffer.

bits.1: ETBEI - Enable Transmit Holding Register Empty Interrupt

registers.name: IIR_FCR
registers.notes: IIR bit 0 = 1 means no interrupt pending

bits.7: DLAB - Divisor Latch Access Bit (when set, offset 0/1 access DLL/DLM)

bits.0: DR - Data Ready (RX buffer has data)
bits.5: THRE - Transmit Holding Register Empty (ready for next byte)

programming_model.transmit: Write byte to THR (offset 0x00). LSR bit 5 (THRE) indicates ready.
programming_model.receive: Read byte from RBR (offset 0x00). LSR bit 0 (DR) indicates data available.
programming_model.initial_state: LSR has THRE bit set (transmitter always ready). RX buffer empty.
